description: This Go source file implements functions to locate, ensure, and manage a 'pi' runtime executable, including environment variable configurations, path resolutions, and installation procedures.

classes.name: docsPiCommand
classes.description: Struct representing the executable and arguments for the 'pi' runtime command.

methods.name: resolveDocsPiCommand
methods.description: Resolves the 'pi' command to execute, considering environment variables, existing PATH, and whether to materialize a runtime.

methods.name: shouldMaterializePiRuntime
methods.description: Determines if the 'pi' runtime should be materialized based on its path.

methods.name: ensureMaterializedPiRuntime
methods.description: Ensures that the 'pi' runtime is available locally, installing it if necessary.

methods.name: getMaterializedPiRuntimeDir
methods.description: Returns the directory path where the materialized 'pi' runtime is stored.

methods.name: getMaterializedPiPackageVersion
methods.description: Fetches the package version of the 'pi' runtime, defaulting if not set via environment variable.
